name: The Sump Lantern
district: Ninth Turn, under the old pumphouse
description: A low-ceilinged bar built into a decommissioned pump hall. Aether-cooled pipes run overhead and sweat onto the tables; the light is a green-gold glow from a cracked conduit nobody has the money to fix. Couriers, mechanics and people waiting for work drink here, and fixers keep booths in the back.

sights: condensation dripping from an Aether-cooled pipe overhead
a cracked conduit throwing green-gold light that flickers when the grid surges
chalked tallies of who owes the bar what, on a slate by the taps
a card game at the next table going sour
a dead pump wheel bolted to the wall as decoration, still faintly humming
sounds: the conduit's low buzz rising and falling with the grid
a goblin band two stairs down, bass coming up through the floor
glass on glass as the bartender stacks cups without looking
smells: fried river-eel and burnt chili oil
the ozone tang of raw Aether bleeding from the pipes
spilled fermented root beer and wet wool
current: Consortium surveyors were seen on the lower stairs this week
Someone chalked an Animist spiral on the back door

walkOns.label: the bartender
walkOns.name: Dunmar
walkOns.look: broad, grey-stubbled man with Aether burn scars up both forearms
walkOns.manner: answers questions with prices; kinder than he sounds
walkOns.role: runs the bar and the slate of who owes what

extras: a pair of off-duty Couriers arguing about routes
a card table of goblin salvagers
